verdict.rationale: Sentry's Alerts take action automatically when issues match pre-defined rules, and the documented actions include notifications, ticket creation, webhooks and other integrations. Seer Autofix also scans incoming issues automatically to automate triage and can open PRs. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of rule condition and filter depth (e.g., thresholds, environments, frequency), and independent or hands-on corroboration of rule-driven automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Sentry's Alerts take action when issues in your organization match pre-defined rules. An alert can send notifications, create tickets, call webhooks, or use other integrations
Send a notification to your team's Slack channel when a **new** issue is created.
Automatically scan issues as they come into Sentry, finding root causes, and automating triage.
